name: grafyx-workspace
description: Workspace for the grafyx TypeScript packages.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/atlas/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/data-structures/test/*.test.ts packages/graph/test/*.test.ts packages/reactive/test/*.test.ts packages/integrations/test/*.test.ts packages/atlas/test/*.test.ts test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='packages/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='packages/**/test/**' --test-coverage-exclude='packages/atlas/src/ui/**' --test-coverage-exclude='packages/atlas/src/server.ts' --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=95 packages/data-structures/test/*.test.ts packages/graph/test/*.test.ts packages/reactive/test/*.test.ts packages/integrations/test/*.test.ts packages/atlas/test/*.test.ts test/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run bench:regression && npm run build && npm run package:smoke
